plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Cyan / Ciena Z-Series BOSS optical transport modules. It reports intake, exhaust and PSU temperatures in Celsius, module current, dual power-feed state and feed voltage, plus uptime and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 28533). Temperature, current and voltage are scaled from milli-units in the collector.
name: Transmission

metrics.name: intake_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Intake air temperature of each Cyan BOSS module in degrees Celsius, scaled from milli-Celsius. Values outside -40 to 125 Celsius are dropped.

metrics.name: exhaust_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Exhaust air temperature of each Cyan BOSS module in degrees Celsius, scaled from milli-Celsius. Values outside -40 to 125 Celsius are dropped.

metrics.name: psu_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Power-supply temperature of each Cyan BOSS module in degrees Celsius, scaled from milli-Celsius. Values outside -40 to 125 Celsius are dropped.

metrics.name: device_current_amps
metrics.description: Supply current of each Cyan BOSS module in amperes, scaled from milli-amperes.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Power-feed state of each Cyan BOSS module feed A/B. on maps to normal, off maps to abnormal, and unknown is not emitted.

metrics.name: device_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Voltage of each Cyan BOSS module feed A/B in volts, scaled from milli-volts. Non-positive values are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of total bytes received by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counters.

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: This metric represents the average rate of total bytes sent by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counters.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the Cyan BOSS module and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
